HotBee Transcript v1.0.3 Changelog

- Updated CLI package reference in documentation from `hotbee-api-skills#v1.0.5` to `hotbee-social-data-skills#v1.1.0`.

hotbee-transcript 1.0.2

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md and api references.
- Improved configuration or agent details in agents/openai.yaml.

Add official HotBee website links and GitHub source provenance

Hotbee-transcript 1.0.0

- Initial release of the HotBee audio/video transcription skill.
- Converts audio or video to text using HotBee speech-to-text, supporting file URLs, video URLs, and extracting transcripts from social videos.
- Enforces lawful media use and API key security practices.
- Provides guidance for CLI usage and API parameter documentation.
